correctness.rationale: Proof independently rederived: swapping adjacent unlike agents requires the exterior neighbors in opposite order, exactly forbidding two consecutive singleton runs; disjoint-singleton bound n>=3r and equality alternating colors; explicit composition-wise run-length construction attains the admissible maximum; monochromatic edge count yields welfare n-2r. Independently implemented agent-payoff enumeration checks 131036 words in 119 fixed-composition cases for n=3..16, and 6215 constructed witnesses for n=3..112. Computations are corroboration, not proof.

originality.rationale: Bilò et al. (2022) Theorem 13 proves the same local game but, for larger color group less than twice smaller, only an LPoA upper bound; explicit statement of tightness excludes this region. The new exact if-and-only-if equilibrium attainability, divisibility-three defect, and constructed lower bounds imply a classification not in the materially inspected Section 3.3. Brandt et al. 2012 concerns a distinct random swap model. Searches did not expose stronger later coverage; equivalent word-avoidance results remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: Closes the directly cited 2022 non-tight local two-color cycle regime with a sharp fixed-composition theorem; exposes a genuine arithmetic obstruction at n divisible by three and gives explicit optimum witnesses for every feasible count. It is not merely a textbook derivation of the known r<=floor(n/3) upper bound, because the equality obstruction and universal constructions are essential to exact welfare.
